scope: Final preparation evidence review, not independent scientific approval or S07 execution.

import_smoke.case_argv: Exact frozen probe argv supplied in each child; runpy run_name is import-only, so __main__ guard is false. No parser/main/probe call.
import_smoke.guarded_calls: Profile rejects calls to main/probe or known qualification/witness/compiler entrypoints before body execution; zero blocked attempts and zero witness calls.
import_smoke.reason: B/C import PassiveObserver before the probe. Python first initializes phase3_mask_edit_refine/__init__.py, which imports .models; these two modules therefore precede the probe. A reaches them later via normal legacy imports.
import_smoke.finding_boundary: No default RNG/hash change or thread/CUDA issue was observed at the recorded import checkpoints. This does not prove arbitrary import side effects or runtime noninterference are absent. Literal three-arm business import-order equality is not met.
import_smoke.production_comparison_unchanged: Relative paths/observer omission are descriptive smoke comparisons only. Production receipt/transcript comparison retains all fields and RNG digests; no path normalization or exclusions added.

storage_review.cleanup: Only test-owned unchanged files and empty directories removed; no recursion or foreign-file deletion. No business output or startup snapshot created.
storage_review.repeat_requirement: Repeat all live location/reservation/free-space checks at any future approved launch; this is not indefinite storage assurance.

review_disposition.storage_and_import_compatibility: Targeted evidence collected; storage checks passed and imports completed without witness or observed RNG/thread/CUDA changes.
review_disposition.required_independent_decision: Explicitly determine whether the documented two-module early import is permissible as a disclosed instrumentation/startup difference. If strict identical order is required, a separately reviewed startup change and new smoke evidence are needed. Neither acceptance nor a new preload policy was applied here.
review_disposition.A_historical_standard: Full strict business receipt equality unchanged; any controlled-A versus historical difference still stops before B.

attempt_accounting.preliminary_note: Initial development smoke retained harness argv; final acceptance smoke repeated with exact frozen business argv. Both were import-only; neither executed main/probe/witness.
